//: Compiler options for the deployed build only.
Each package has its own tsconfig and `pnpm typecheck` runs those explicitly,
so this file is not part of the local gate. It exists because Vercel compiles
api/index.ts on its own, without a tsconfig of its own, and falls back to the
compiler's defaults: CommonJS, no DOM library. Those defaults are wrong twice
over. The API is built on the Web platform types, so `Request`, `Response` and
`Headers` must come from lib.dom, not from @types/node, and the source uses
`import.meta` to decide whether it is the process entry point, which CommonJS
skipLibCheck is on for the usual reason: a dependency's own declarations are
not ours to fix, and one of them failing would block every deploy.
